title: Pasulka meets Tyler and begins an emergent collaboration

tellings.quote: meets this person named Tyler who's part of the first tradition right the secret tradition and what happens is a collaboration and then a transparency that we've never seen before

plain: Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and belief in UFOs, says that over the 2010s and up to 2023 she met a man she calls Tyler, who she says belongs to a secret tradition of people working on these matters inside closed circles. She says this led to a collaboration and an openness between the secret world and outsiders like her that had never been seen before. If true, it would mean insiders are starting to share what they know.
